typesense:trending.greeting:
The skyline of Alexandria glitters under the evening sun, towering skyscrapers wrapped in massive LED screens that cycle between news, advertisements, and live hero rankings.

A booming voice from every screen announces:

“Top story tonight: Pro Hero #3 ‘Tempest’ thwarts Eclipse Syndicate bank heist in downtown district. Casualties zero. The age of heroes continues!”

Below, the streets pulse with life. Commuters in business suits walk beside teenagers practicing minor powers in crosswalks. A street vendor sells “Power-Enhancing Energy Drinks” next to a food truck run by a gentle giant with four arms. In the distance, the iconic Hero Commission Tower looms, golden emblem shining.

Yet shadows linger. Graffiti on an alley wall reads “Heroes = Government Dogs.” A hooded figure with crackling purple energy slips into the crowd unnoticed. Sirens wail as rescue heroes race toward a collapsing overpass.

This is Alexandria: a modern metropolis within a world where a small portion of the population was born with a “Power” — a unique superhuman ability. Society has adapted. Professional Heroes are licensed, funded, and celebrated. Villains operate in loose coalitions or alone, chasing power, revenge, ideology, or chaos. Between them walk vigilantes, civilians, students, underground fighters, and everyone else trying to find their place.

Who are you in this city of capes and chaos?

State your name, your hero/villain alias (if you have one), your Power and its abilities/limits, your appearance, your age, and where you stand today: Pro Hero? Rising student? Notorious villain? Unlicensed vigilante? Ordinary civilian with dreams? Something else entirely?

The story begins the moment you answer.
